title: PPG Review Annotations
description: Suggestions for later PPG review. Version-bound evidence, not policy approval. Retain discussion and decision history.

fields.name: AnnotationKey
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="AnnotationKey" StaticName="AnnotationKey" DisplayName="Annotation key" Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: DocumentUID
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="DocumentUID" StaticName="DocumentUID" DisplayName="Document UID" Required="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: DocumentVersion
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="DocumentVersion" StaticName="DocumentVersion" DisplayName="Document version" Required="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: SectionId
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="SectionId" StaticName="SectionId" DisplayName="Section identifier" Required="FALSE"></Field>

fields.name: OriginalSuggestion
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="OriginalSuggestion" StaticName="OriginalSuggestion" DisplayName="Suggestion and additions" Required="TRUE" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: EvidenceRef
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="EvidenceRef" StaticName="EvidenceRef" DisplayName="Evidence links" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: DecisionRationale
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="DecisionRationale" StaticName="DecisionRationale" DisplayName="Decision rationale" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: IncorporatedVersion
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="IncorporatedVersion" StaticName="IncorporatedVersion" DisplayName="Incorporated in version" Required="FALSE"></Field>

identity: Native list item ID; optional unique AnnotationKey for idempotent integrations
history: Version history and append-only note fields preserve prior contributions; not a security boundary against administrators
formInstructions: Use the catalogue DocumentUID and the exact document version. Title is a short summary. Add evidence links. A suggested change does not change policy authority.
